evidence.note: The genealogy closes with וּמְתוּשָׁאֵל יָלַד אֶת לָמֶךְ, “and Methushael fathered Lamech.”
The second Lamech is named in וַיּוֹלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ לֶמֶךְ, “he fathered a son and called his name Lamech.”

name: לֶמֶךְ
note: The initial ל belongs to the name. The final consonant is ך, and the verse gives no support for deriving the name from למד.
summary: Genesis 4:18 names Lamech as the son of Methushael. The meaning of the name is uncertain.
